display.summary: Second 1.16 beta: fixes on top of 1.16.0b1's built-in task manager. Replaced document files stay on disk for audits again, the backup page's restore history refreshes on a deployment with no restores yet, and System Settings no longer stalls when the mail relay's name does not resolve. A 1.16.0b1 deployment updates inline; from 1.15.x, follow the 1.16.0b1 upgrade path.
highlights: Document history keeps the replaced file and the PDF upload in the document's folder again, beside their history copy, for audits.
Backup page: the restore history refreshes live on a deployment with no restores yet; its status poller returned an error.
System Settings opens without delay when the mail relay's name does not resolve: the relay check waits at most 1.5 seconds in total.
From 1.16.0b1 this beta installs inline. From 1.15.x: put the project image on 1.16, run ./start.sh check --fix with Composer 1.10+, recreate.
Includes 1.16.0b1: DjangoLux runs its own tasks in a worker service instead of Celery, and projects get the dlux.taskrunner API.
